messages:
maya (Sales): BeaconBank needs a question-by-question SIG upload by EOD. They specifically flagged encryption at rest, key rotation logs, and multi-tenant isolation evidence.
ethan (Solutions): I can take network + runtime isolation Qs. Will start a short writeup.
maya (Sales): Thanks. I started a Confluence checklist: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SALES/pages/Beacon+SIG+pack
riya (Security): Heads up 95 we keep KMS rotation artifacts in secure S3. The object has key IDs; legal asked we redact IDs before sharing.
alex (Sales Ops): Redacted summary is fine usually. We'll need a manifest.csv of files we upload for the vendor portal.
tom (Engineering): For isolation proof, I'll export the tenant mapping report and a sanitized host-list showing only hostnames, no IPs.
riya (Security): Also pulling IAM access review SUP-4521 and privilege escalation logs for the last 12 months. Will produce a redacted PDF.
>deploy-bot: sig-package-assemble triggered by riya at 18:12 UTC
maya (Sales): Important: Beacon's security team asked for the rotation cadence and proof of last three rotations. Can we supply timestamps and rotation method without key material?
riya (Security): Yes 95 rotation cadence: 90 days; rotations occurred: 2023-11-12T02:14Z, 2024-02-10T02:10Z, 2024-05-09T02:05Z. I'll include certificate fingerprints and hashes only.
ethan (Solutions): On the CAIQ section 'network segmentation' I'll note: private subnets, no internet egress from model hosts, egress via NAT gateways with logging.
maya (Sales): Do we have an architecture diagram they can accept? Sometimes their vendor portal strips SVGs. PDF preferred.
tom (Engineering): Uploading a PDF export to Confluence now. Diagram shows VPCs, peering, bastion SSO, and dedicated GPU pools.
alex (Sales Ops): Once riya drops the redacted zip, I'll assemble portal package and generate manifest.csv. ETA 45 mins after zip ready.
riya (Security): Zipped and redacted package uploaded to internal share: https://files.redwood.internal/secure/beaconbank/sig_package_redacted_v1.zip. MD5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e
maya (Sales): Perfect. I'll submit to their vendor portal and attach the manifest. Will log submission in Opportunity 67890 and flag for exec review.
ethan (Solutions): Quick note for the 'data residency' question: we can confirm customer can choose region in Dedicated/Private. Hosted default region is us-west-2 for Beacon orgs.
maya (Sales): Added that line. Legal review?
riya (Security): Legal sign-off not required for these redactions; compliance reviewed earlier.
alex (Sales Ops): Submitted to Beacon portal at 18:52 UTC. Portal ID: BB-SIG-20240523-01.
>deploy-bot: portal-submission event: BB-SIG-20240523-01 created by alex
maya (Sales): Thanks all. If Beacon's team comes back with follow-ups, post here and we'll triage. :thumbsup:
